title: The Confirmation Page
lede: After they book, help them confirm attendance. Video, confirmation email, calendar invite.
body:
The congratulations page is where a qualified applicant books. This page comes after that booking. Its job is to help them confirm they will attend, not give them another form or calendar.

Use this structure

Open our confirmation-page demo. It shows the order: confirmation headline, short video, confirmation-email action and calendar invitation.

Adapt this example to your branding, sender and real booking setup. Add case studies or reviews only when you have your own authorised proof.

  1. Confirm attendance: open the confirmation email and click the real attendance button. This needs a connected email-confirmation action.
  2. Accept the invitation: add the appointment to their calendar.
  3. Proof, if you have it: authorised case studies and genuine reviews. No reviews means no review section. No case studies means no results grid.

The video

Keep it short and make the next action clear.

Thanks for booking. To confirm you’re attending, open the confirmation email from [sender] and click [the real attendance button]. Then accept the calendar invitation so the appointment is in your diary.

On the call we’ll look at [their problem] and whether [your service] is the right way to solve it. See you then.

That email instruction must match a real connected action. If you only send a calendar invitation, explain that actual step instead. Don’t claim a video view or page visit confirms attendance.

Give Jarvis the job

Run the confirmation page skill for my landing page. Video: [link, or "not filmed yet, leave a placeholder"].

Jarvis reads your saved funnel and checks the booking and confirmation setup. Use one post-booking confirmation page. Already-confirmed prospects should see a completed message, not another demand to confirm.

Test the connection

Book a test slot, find the confirmation email, use the attendance action and accept the invite. Check the meeting details and that the provider records the actual action. Until the sender and event are connected, the page is a draft. Internal error-state tests are not extra customer pages.
